baseline.failure: ('Sustain value did not change on screen', [])
('Sustain value did not change on screen', [])

rationale: Sustain and Sostenuto in the Syntakt configuration carried nrpn_msb/lsb/min/max = -1 placeholders. Lua treats -1 as present, so param_manager built an NRPN parameter whose range collapsed to the Off value -1: turning E3 changed nothing and no MIDI was sent. Removing the placeholders leaves them as the CC 64 / CC 66 parameters the configuration defines. Only the Syntakt configuration used -1 placeholders for NRPN numbers.
oracle: README 546: all CC parameters are accessible for editing and any value other than Off is sent to the device; the configuration maps Sustain to CC 64 and Sostenuto to CC 66 (MIDI 1.0 pedal controllers).
collateral: All Lua units pass (the unit that pinned the collapsed range now pins the CC parameters and fails on the old configuration); Mute (NRPN) remains the in-case control.
